ledger.scope: Funded modeled parent orders; actual venue partial fills are verified separately in native control fixtures.

openEnd.rule: exact: the orders the engine executed in the run and still open at its end (every gate, cap and Block volume applied), marked to market at the last close

caps.source: balance-volume defaults (no balance caps in the settings)

admission.scope: Independently valid settled candidates absent from the recorded selection; actual production activation rules, retained rank/recent/minimum-history gates. This is not permission to bypass shared risk gates.
admission.entryActivationScope: Own activation rules at the exact candidate entry, separate from the earlier selection clock. Active here still needs global rank/cap, risk, funding and native execution proof; it is not an assertion of a missing funded order.
